e.title: Nelson-Siegel-Svensson (Python)
e.summary: Nelson-Siegel-Svensson 收益率曲线拟合 Python 实现（OSM/Ronald Richman，MIT）
e.body: Nelson-Siegel-Svensson 是金融/精算领域最流行的收益率曲线参数化方法之一。本仓库是 Ronald Richman（Open Source Modelling）的 Python 实现：拟合 NSS 曲线参数，用于折现率曲线构造（如 EIOPA RFR 外推、负债折现、资产负债管理）。MIT 许可。与 [[solvency2rfr]]（EIOPA RFR 数据）、[[yield-curve]]（收益率曲线工具）、[[open-source-economic-model]]（ALM 模型）互补——数据、拟合、建模三段式。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[lifecontingencies]]、[[financemodels-jl]]。
e.verified_note: GitHub API 核实：18★，MIT，OSM（Ronald Richman）Nelson-Siegel-Svensson 收益率曲线 Python 实现
e.summary_en: Python implementation of the Nelson-Siegel-Svensson yield-curve model (OSM/Ronald Richman, MIT)
e.summary_hk: Nelson-Siegel-Svensson 收益率曲線擬合 Python 實現（OSM/Ronald Richman，MIT）
e.body_en: Nelson-Siegel-Svensson is one of the most popular parametric yield-curve models in finance and actuarial work. This repo is Ronald Richman's (Open Source Modelling) Python implementation: fitting NSS curve parameters for discount-curve construction (e.g. EIOPA RFR extrapolation, liability discounting, asset-liability management). MIT licensed. Complements [[solvency2rfr]] (EIOPA RFR data) and [[yield-curve]] (yield-curve tools) and [[open-source-economic-model]] (ALM) — data, fitting and modelling as a chain. Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[lifecontingencies]], [[financemodels-jl]].
e.body_hk: Nelson-Siegel-Svensson 是金融/精算領域最流行的收益率曲線參數化方法之一。本倉庫是 Ronald Richman（Open Source Modelling）的 Python 實現：擬合 NSS 曲線參數，用於折現率曲線構造（如 EIOPA RFR 外推、負債折現、資產負債管理）。MIT 許可。與 [[solvency2rfr]]（EIOPA RFR 數據）、[[yield-curve]]（收益率曲線工具）、[[open-source-economic-model]]（ALM 模型）互補——數據、擬合、建模三段式。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[lifecontingencies]]、[[financemodels-jl]]。
